blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Vegetation growth is reliant on multiple controlling factors.
The factors influencing growth are categorized into physical and biological types.
Growth outcomes stem from the interaction among these physical and biological elements.
Note that both physical and biological factors jointly control natural vegetation.
Exams frequently test the dual physical and biological dependencies of vegetation growth.

cells: Temperature determines growing season while rainfall controls density of vegetation. Areas with >200 cm rainfall support evergreen forests, whereas <25 cm rainfall leads to deserts.
Soil fertility, depth, texture and drainage directly affect root penetration and nutrient availability.
Altitude influences temperature; slopes affect moisture retention. South-facing slopes in the Northern Hemisphere receive more sunlight.
Regions with shallow water tables support lush vegetation even with moderate rainfall.
Human interference, grazing, pests and forest fires modify vegetation patterns.
